cards.name: Diving Daughters of the Grand Blue

effects.printed_clause: If Normal or Special Summoned: send a Grand Blue monster from Deck to GY.
effects.lua_implementation: Cloned delayed Normal/Special Summon triggers share one count key and send one set monster from Deck.

official_references.matched_structure: Foolish Burial supplies the official Deck-to-GY operation.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to GY by card effect: target another Grand Blue card you control or in GY.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed EVENT_TO_GRAVE checks REASON_EFFECT and targets another own set card from field/GY.

official_references.matched_structure: Shaddoll Squamata demonstrates an EVENT_TO_GRAVE condition specifically requiring card-effect reason.

effects.printed_clause: Special Summon this card in Defense Position.
effects.lua_implementation: The target is used only as activation information. Resolution now checks the handler, Necrovalley, and zone availability directly, so the self-Special-Summon does not depend on the informational target remaining related or retaining its archetype.

official_references.matched_structure: Big Belly Knight demonstrates a GY-trigger Special Summon that does not operate on an activation-information target.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the previous operation incorrectly aborted if the targeted Grand Blue card left its location or ceased to satisfy the archetype filter.

effects.printed_clause: Banish it if it leaves the field.
effects.lua_implementation: After successful summon, LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT points to banishment with RESETS_REDIRECT.

official_references.matched_structure: Special Summon from hand or GY, then apply a leave-field redirect that banishes the summoned monster.

effects.printed_clause: Each effect is once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The two effects use id/id+100; summon clones share id.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed and removed an improper resolution dependency on an informational target.

coverage_override.reason: The audit records split this card into its material/procedure, restrictions, activated or continuous operations, and printed count-limit clauses; no printed functional clause is omitted.
